basics.name: Michael Galbraith Purvis
basics.label: Technical Leadership · Project & Product Management
basics.summary: Engineering leader with 20 years in new-product development, moving deliberately from hands-on engineering into project and product leadership. I've led cross-functional delivery across three vehicle programs at an EV manufacturer; managed a 5-engineer R&D team and third-party development studios in regulated casino gaming; carried Project Manager and Site Manager duties on a federal simulation contract while titled Senior Software Engineer; and founded a consultancy where I own scope, schedule, phased delivery plans, and client outcomes end to end. Deep, current fluency in generative-AI tooling and AI-assisted delivery — and pursuing PMP certification. A career spent building demanding real-time software, now focused on leading the teams and programs that deliver products.
